subject: PO Field Lockdown & weekly sweep exception request
messages:
From: Jordan Price <procurement@healthlynx.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Soto <maya.soto@healthlynx.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO field lockdown & weekly sweep exception request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Procurement at HealthLynx has one constraint that will drive our invoicing approach: treasury requires a weekly consolidated statement (weekly sweep) instead of the standard monthly statement your billing team offers.

A few specifics we need confirmed before we can issue a formal PO:
- PO header fields must include: PO_NUMBER, BILLING_ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, COST_CENTER, and ORIGINATOR_EMAIL. These are mandatory for our ERP to match invoices.
- Each invoice must surface a HealthLynx PO ID in the invoice header and in the first metadata column of the CSV we process.
- Net terms requested: Net45 (HealthLynx policy). If Redwood needs Net60 as standard, tell us the delta so we can escalate.
- We will sometimes split volume across two POs (regional BU separation); invoices must be taggable to a single PO line or aggregated under the weekly sweep rollup.

I attached our PO template so your finance and billing teams can confirm the fields. Can Redwood accept weekly sweeps and the PO metadata mapping? Also please call out any packaging/discount impacts if we move to weekly consolidated billing versus monthly.

We'd like to get a small SOW redline for the billing cadence changes to attach to the PO when procurement issues it.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Price
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthLynx
procurement@healthlynx.com

Jordan — thanks for the details and the template. Looping Vanessa (commercial ops) to validate pricing/packaging impact. A couple quick clarifying questions to make sure we scope the change correctly:

1) When you say "weekly consolidated statement," do you need an aggregated single invoice file per week (one PDF + CSV rollup) or individual invoices per PO that we also provide a weekly rollup CSV?
2) For split-volume POs: do you require line-level aggregation (concat SKU rows) or separate invoice lines per shipment? Our billing engine can do either but the mapping has different downstream impacts.
3) ACH / bank onboarding — will HealthLynx be open to doing ACH for the Net45 requirement? If not, we need to map how we maintain payment guarantees for Net45.

If you can confirm the answers by EOD tomorrow we'll draft a minimal billing addendum for the SOW and check discount banding effects.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 9:12 AM Jordan Price <procurement@healthlynx.com> wrote:
> Hi Olga,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week...

Hi Olga — quick answers:
- We need one consolidated invoice package per week (one signed PDF invoice + one CSV with line mapping for the week). HealthFinance imports the weekly CSV into our AP system.
- For split-volume POs, please keep line-level rows separate (do not concat SKUs). HealthFinance relies on unique line ids for matching.
- ACH is preferred and will accelerate Net45 acceptance; we can request finance to prioritize ACH onboarding but it often takes 10-14 business days. For the purchase order we're willing to issue with Net45 conditional on receipt of ACH setup confirmation within 30 days of the first invoice.

Attached the PO template and a sample PO ID format we use (HLX-PO-YYYY-#####). Let me know if Redwood can produce the mapping CSV and the weekly rollup.

Regards,
Jordan

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the quick clarifications. A few commercial notes from pricing/packaging perspective:

- Weekly sweep increases bill-run frequency and reduces our ability to net token/usage-level smoothing across a month. That creates additional per-invoice cost (AP processing + reporting) which we typically offset via a small surcharge or by adjusting commitment buckets.
- Our standard approach is to: (a) accept weekly rollups for the first 60-90 days of onboarding to support customer cashflow, and (b) revert to monthly for steady-state unless the customer accepts a 1-2% surcharge to cover the operational overhead.

Proposals for HealthLynx:
1) Option A (no surcharge): Weekly sweep for first 90 days; monthly thereafter.
2) Option B (no cadence change): Monthly statements but provide a weekly CSV export to your AP for visibility.
3) Option C (sustained weekly): Permanent weekly sweep with a 1.5% operational surcharge applied to invoice totals (crediting eligibility for existing volume discounts unchanged).

We will model the discount impact on packaging (committed slabs) once you tell us which option you prefer. From a contract standpoint, we can draft a 1-page billing addendum that enumerates PO header mapping and the cadence.

Sharing to Vivek for finance/ops mapping (see question about CSV format).

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO field lockdown & weekly sweep exception request

Jordan / Team — finance ops here. Operational notes and a proposed compromise:

1) Weekly sweep creates extra AP work (file generation, signing, and reconciliation). We can support it but need: (a) a strict PO header mapping (we've attached a sample CSV with column headers we require), and (b) a clear rule for split-PO attribution. Our billing engine will generate a weekly CSV that matches the attached header order: PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_ID, BILLING_ENTITY_ID, BU_CODE, COST_CENTER, INVOICE_TOTAL, NET_DUE_DATE, PAYMENT_METHOD.
2) Net45: We are willing to accept Net45 under these conditions: ACH onboarding confirmation within 30 days OR a one-time security deposit (1 invoice amount) held for 60 days. Otherwise we must default to Net60.
3) Compromise path: approve Option A from Vanessa — weekly sweep for onboarding (90 days) then monthly steady-state. For long-term weekly, we will need the 1.5% operational surcharge.

I've attached the sample mapping CSV for your AP team to test with. If HealthLynx confirms Option A and ACH timeline, we will deliver the billing addendum and a redline to the SOW for countersignature.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: po_header_mapping_sample.csv (CSV)

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO field lockdown & weekly sweep exception request

Vivek / Vanessa / Olga — thanks for the clear options and the sample CSV. HealthLynx accepts the compromise: Option A (weekly sweep for onboarding 90 days, monthly thereafter). Conditions from our side:
- We will begin ACH onboarding and aim to complete within 14 business days; if there is a delay we will notify Redwood and provide the security deposit (as you described).
- We will adopt the CSV header mapping you attached. Our AP team will run an import test next Tuesday and confirm.
- Please circulate the one-page billing addendum + redlined SOW and we will coordinate internal procurement sign-off.

Once we have the addendum, we'll issue the PO (HLX-PO-2026-04567) with Net45 conditional on ACH confirmation. Please send the DocuSign link for the addendum and the redlined SOW.

Appreciate your flexibility — Jordan
